operation_details.item: The user prefers casual chatty tone with jokes and emoji in internal audit findings emails instead of formal compliance language.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Morning! How’s the budget review going today—smooth sailing, or has Excel decided to become your biggest audit finding? 😄

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Morning! A little of both. I’m wrapping up the internal audit findings email before I send it to the team.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice—want a hand polishing it? I can make it concise and clear without making it sound like it was written by a committee of compliance robots.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, please. I prefer those emails to sound casual and chatty, with a little joke and maybe an emoji, rather than using very formal compliance language.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Got it. We can keep the findings precise but make the tone more human—for example, “A few receipts went on an unexpected vacation 🧾✈️; please upload them by Friday.”

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly—that’s much closer to my style. I’ll paste in the draft and we can give it a friendly cleanup.
